title: Oil Kissed Filipino Dried White Corn Grill
description: A garlicky and light Filipino dish featuring dried white corn, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and offers a char-grill flavor.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the soaked and drained dried white corn, minced garlic, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper until the corn is well coated.
Grill the corn mixture for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly charred.
Remove the corn from the grill and stir in the lemon juice.
Transfer the corn to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
Serve the Oil Kissed Filipino Dried White Corn Grill hot, straight from the grill.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving if desired.
